description: Retention of use of a retail shop as a restaurant (Use Class A3) including installation of a ventilation extraction duct on the rear elevation of the building, retention of shopfront and single storey rear extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: from 9:00am to 10:30pm Mondays to Friday and 9am to 10:30pm on Saturdays and 11am to10pm Sundays and Bank Holidays.

Condition : 4 - No amplified or other music from 9:00am to 10:30pm five days a week and 9am to 10:30pm on Saturdays and 11am to 10pm Sundays.
.

Condition : 5 - Within 3 months of the date of this permission, full particulars and details of a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the toilets shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be implemented within 3 months of the approval and shall be permanently retained thereafter..

Condition : 6 - Within three months of the date of this permission, full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the takeaway and the residential flats above, shall be submitted to and and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and shall be implemented within 3 months of the approval and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 7 - Within three months of the date of this permission, provision shall be made for a secure storage area within the site either within an existing building or one that has the benefit of planning permission, or enclosed by a 2-metre high close boarded fence with gates, which are to be kept shut at all times except when access is required, to house not less than two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins shall be provided and made available for use, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanentlyavailable and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal weekly collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.

Condition : 8 - The kitchen extract system shown on the approved drawings shall be implemented within 3 months of the date of this permission in accordance with approved details and shall comply with the following specifications.
The system shall be designed so that the maximum operation shall not result in noise has a rating level is not less than 10dB below the background level, measured in accordance with BS4142, 1997. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:
a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.
b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.
c) The ducting shall be circular.
d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.
e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.
f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.
g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
